replies.author: Avidead
replies.body:
Hello,

                      Unfortunately after reviewing evidence, I have concluded that you were indeed using a client modification. The evidence is quite clear, don't feel afraid to appeal again in due time.
Evidence: https://www.youtube.com/watch?t=19&v=TFtUv-CBDdk

Thanks,
BiasedSeniorMod,
Avicus Network Senior Staff
